item.title: Pantograph 1.1.10
item.description:
New

  • Save As… when you leave an edited photo. Switching to another file, closing or quitting with unsaved edits now offers Save, Save As…, Don't Save and Cancel. Save As… (⇧⌘S) writes a copy and leaves the original as it was; cancelling it keeps you where you are.

If you have Pantograph 1.1.3 or later, it will offer this update by itself (1.1.7 and later install it quietly when you quit). Otherwise, download Pantograph-1.1.10.zip, unzip it and drag Pantograph to Applications. Requires macOS 13 or later; runs natively on Apple silicon and Intel. Signed and notarized by Apple.
